name: Generic Activity Types
abstract: The catalog of the generic activity types: one concept scheme per family of related types, under https://w3id.org/ogc/ospd/activity-type/.
description:
# Generic Activity Types

The generic activity types of the Activity Types Register, under stable URIs of the form
`https://w3id.org/ogc/ospd/activity-type/<slug>`. Federated registers, such as the OSPD activity types register, specialise them (`skos:broader`).

This block holds the catalog (`https://w3id.org/ogc/ospd/activity-type/catalog`), which lists the profile ontologies of this register and one
`skos:ConceptScheme` per family of related generic activity types. Each family is a building block that profiles this one and
carries its concept scheme and the Turtle definitions of its activity types.

Every activity type is a `skos:Concept` and an `acttype:ActivityType` (Registered Item Model), has a `skos:prefLabel`, and
records the IRIs it replaces (`dcterms:replaces`), equivalent aliases (`skos:exactMatch`) and likely duplicates
(`skos:closeMatch`).

## Families

- **Vector geometry processing** (`ogc.register.types.vector-geometry-processing`): Operations and tests on vector geometries: buffers, hulls, envelopes, set operations, spatial predicates and extents (including the SQL/MM implementations).
- **Raster and coverage processing** (`ogc.register.types.raster-coverage-processing`): Operations on rasters and coverages: reprojection, resampling, cropping, mosaicking, format conversion, rendering, band math, spectral indices and zonal analysis.
- **Earth observation** (`ogc.register.types.earth-observation`): Earth-observation data access and applications: Sentinel-2 band retrieval and product selection, cloud and best-available-pixel handling, and the water-bodies, algae-bloom and mangrove-biomass workflows.
- **Terrain and hydrology** (`ogc.register.types.terrain-and-hydrology`): Terrain derivatives (slope, hillshading, ruggedness and position indices) and hydrological analysis (flow direction and accumulation, watersheds, stream networks, wetness index).
- **Spatial indexing** (`ogc.register.types.spatial-indexing`): Discrete global grid system (DGGS) indexing and conversion of geometries to grid cells.
- **Point-cloud processing** (`ogc.register.types.point-cloud-processing`): Point-cloud thinning, gridding and conversion to shapes.
- **Machine learning and statistical modeling** (`ogc.register.types.ml-and-statistical-modeling`): Machine-learning and statistical activities: regression, climate-variable downscaling, super-resolution and trend analysis, and inference executions.
- **Information extraction and retrieval** (`ogc.register.types.information-extraction-and-retrieval`): Source acquisition, text metadata enrichment (entity extraction, geotagging, classification, normalization) and retrieval-augmented generation.
- **Workflow and scoring** (`ogc.register.types.workflow-and-scoring`): Workflow runs and scoring or classification activities used in the model-of-models and workflow examples.
